purpose: Machine-checkable record of the sweep-pollution classes disclosed by t95 option B and re-measured by the t102 groom, with an owner and a disposition per class. The repository-side boundary change (build/ and scratch/ added to SKIP_DIRS in backend/scripts/docs_verification.py) ships with t102; every class below is recorded here so copy/junction dirt cannot silently reach a verification leg again.

classes.symptom: A copied repository subtree or junction planted under build/ or scratch/ leaks its *.md into the in-repo verifier's os.walk, so the committed LINK_CHECK leg counts copied dirt: groom executed the pre-fix report as LINK_CHECK FAIL broken=4 with every break from copied dirt and none from a tracked document; the unfixed live walk reached 2404 *.md against 280 under the boundary.
classes.surface: backend/scripts/docs_verification.py SKIP_DIRS (line 96) and the walk in check_links(); the committed report docs/criteria/docs_verification.md LINK_CHECK files= line (265 -> 261 on a clean tree: the four tracked *.md under build/ leave the walk's document set).
classes.owner: this repository - shipped by t102: build and scratch added to SKIP_DIRS, report regenerated by the generator (never hand-edited).
classes.disposition: CLOSED by t102 for the in-repo verifier: the candidate walk is blind to planted build/ and scratch/ dirt (ac4 arm A), the pre-fix boundary still fires on the same dirt (ac4 arm P), and a broken link in a tracked document still fires under the boundary walk (ac4 arm C). The gitignore question (adding scratch/ to .gitignore) is a separate operator decision this card deliberately does not take; build/ is already gitignored at .gitignore line 185.

classes.symptom: A .env file left in the checkout changes verification behaviour (WAL 1190 hygiene): the copy/use/remove discipline exists precisely because a present .env has broken verification runs before.
classes.surface: repository root .env; quarantine location scratch/env_quarantine_t94post (copy from there, use, and REMOVE immediately); ac3 enforces absence as a preflight before certifying any regeneration.
classes.owner: orchestrator/operator run hygiene - not a product surface; no repository code change is in scope for this class.
classes.disposition: OPEN run precondition: .env must not exist in the checkout during any verification run; ac3 REDs with the remedy named if it is present. tests[217] is unrelated to this class at this base - see neighbour_legs.

classes.symptom: t95 defect B2: the sweep runner's allowlist omitted node_modules, so copy/junction-class pollution reached the sweep legs from the runner's own walk (the same dirt class that this card removes from the in-repo verifier).
classes.surface: scratch/t93pm/sweep.cjs class tooling - orchestrator scratch tooling, not a repo artifact. Required exclusion set for that walk: node_modules, build, scratch, .git.
classes.owner: orchestrator scratch tooling - out of scope for this repository; the runner lives outside the repo delta and no fence in this card can reach it.
classes.disposition: RECORDED OBLIGATION ONLY: t102 ships this record naming the exclusion set and the owner. The runner itself is orchestrator-side scratch tooling and is NOT modified from this repository - if the sweep walk needs the allowlist, that is orchestrator housekeeping outside this repository's delta (out of scope per the card).

classes.symptom: A WSL-node environment makes the stored README/render gate re-attestations inside the generator report a STORED_GATES FAIL that is an environment artifact, not product RED; the re-attested legs include the index positions 134 and 155 among the nine stored gates.
classes.surface: backend/scripts/docs_verification.py STORED_GATES re-attestation (re-executes the stored index legs, e.g. 134 and 155, through the interpreter the process happens to get); WSL npx is broken (esbuild win32 binary) so tsx/npx must run via cmd.exe on the canonical host.
classes.owner: run environment - canonical host discipline (native node via cmd.exe); disclosed in the card's Context, not a product surface.
classes.disposition: DISCLOSED environment class: a WSL-node STORED_GATES FAIL is disclosed, never reported as product RED; fences take verdicts from report lines and derived values rather than raw process exit codes where the class can pollute rc.
